title: Aaj Bhi Shabbir Ko
body:
Aaj bhi shabbir ko
(Shah ast hussain, badshaah ast hussain, dee(n) ast hussain, dee(n) panah ast hussain) x2
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×3 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Teen din ki pyaas me shabbir ka wo imtihaan] ×2
Sar zamine karbala roti thi roya aasmaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Samne darya tha lekin tashnalab asgher raha] ×2
Kehti thi bali sakina hai labo par meri jaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Hazrate abbas ke bazu kalam jab hogaye] ×2
Kehti thi zainab saro se uth gaya hai sayebaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Sinaye akbar me barchi toot kar jab rehgayi] ×2
Kehte the imdaad ko jald aayiye ay baba jaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Khoon me asgher naha kar sogaya maidan me] ×2
Deyr tak rote rahe asgher pe sab teero kamaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
(Jab sare shabbir zindaa(n) me sakina ko milaa) x2
Roke dikhlane lagi rukh par tamaacho ke nishaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Yaad ajaata tha akbar madare akbar ko phir] ×2
Jab kabhi kaano me aajati thi awaaze azaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Tukre tukre hogaya kasim ka laasha dasht me] ×2
Laash ke tukre uthate rehgaye shahe zamaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Kal ghame shabbir me zainab ko na rone diya] ×2
Ro raha hai aaj maula aap ko saaraa jahaan
[Aaj bhi shabbir ko, rota hai ye saraa jahaan] ×2 Aaj bhi shabbir ko
[Hazrate "shabbir" ho ya hazrate "abbas" ho] ×2
Degaye "Rehan" dine haq pe dono apni jaan
